publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service
title_or_table: Monthly Treasury Statement, Table 9, Summary of Receipts by Source, and Outlays by Function of the U.S. Government (September issues, fiscal year to date)
universe_or_base: Net federal outlays by budget function, as Treasury reports them
unit: billions of dollars, nominal, rounded by the studio
vintage: September Monthly Treasury Statements as served on November 11, 2026
qualification: Net outlays: two lines can be negative (Commerce and Housing Credit in some years, and Undistributed Offsetting Receipts every year), so a treemap draws only the positive functions and states what it leaves out; functions group spending by purpose, not by agency

function.description: budget function as Treasury names it; Total is all net outlays

outlays_billions.description: net outlays in the fiscal year

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Monthly Treasury Statement, Table 9, outlays by function, fiscal 2026, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Net outlays in nominal dollars; offsetting receipts are shown as negative.

source_line_variants.all_years: Source: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Monthly Treasury Statement, Table 9, outlays by function, fiscal 2015 to 2026, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Net outlays in nominal dollars; offsetting receipts are shown as negative.
